svg.title: A loan payment pays interest and reduces the balance
svg.desc: A conceptual monthly payment bar is divided into interest and principal. An arrow leads to a smaller outstanding balance. In the next period interest is calculated from that remaining balance. Proportions are illustrative, not a loan schedule.

g.text: Follow a payment through the loan
Next period: calculate interest from the new balance, then split the next payment.
Illustrative proportions only. The lesson table and calculator show the actual rounded figures and assumptions.
